kv19.7:2.5: Hañci accantaniyatassa puggalassa vicikicchā uppajjeyya, no vata re vattabbe
kv19.7:4.3: Akusalo maggo nīyāniko khayagāmī bodhagāmī anāsavo --pe-- asaṃkilesiko ti?
kv19.7:4.10: "Accantaniyatassa puggalassa vicikicchā akusalena maggena pahīnā ti." 3.
kv19.7:5.3: Hañci sassatadiṭṭhiniyatassa puggalassa ucchedadiṭṭhi uppajjeyya, no vata re vattabbe
kv19.7:7.3: Akusalo maggo nīyāniko khayagāmī bodhagāmī anāsavo --pe-- asaṃkilesiko ti? Na h' evaṃ vattabbe --pe-- Nanu akusalo maggo anīyāniko saṃkilesiko ti? Āmantā. Hañci akusalo maggo anīyāniko saṃkilesiko, no vata re vattabbe
kv19.7:7.4: "Sassatadiṭṭhiniyatassa puggalassa ucchedadiṭṭhi akusalena maggena pahīnā ti." 5.
kv19.7:8.3: Hañci ucchedadiṭṭhiniyatassa puggalassa sassatadiṭṭhi uppajjeyya, no vata re vattabbe
kv19.7:10.3: Akusalo maggo nīyāniko khayagāmī bodhagāmī anāsavo --pe-- asaṃkilesiko ti? Na h' evaṃ vattabbe --pe-- Nanu akusalo maggo anīyāniko --pe-- saṃkilesiko ti? Āmantā. Hañci akusalo maggo anīyāniko --pe-- saṃkilesiko, no vata re vattabbe
kv19.7:10.4: "Ucchedadiṭṭhiniyatassa puggalassa sassatadiṭṭhi akusalena maggena pahīnā ti." 7.
kv19.7:11.5: "Idha Bhikkhave ekacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekantakāḷakehi akusalehi dhammehi, so sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo va hotīti."
kv19.7:11.8: Tena hi atthi puthujjanassa accantaniyāmatā ti. 8.
kv19.7:12.2: "Idha Bhikkhave ekacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekantakāḷakehi akusalehi dhammehi, so sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo va hotīti" katvā tena ca kāraṇena atthi puthujjanassa accantaniyāmatā ti?
kv19.7:13.2: "Idha Bhikkhave ekacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekantakāḷakehi akusalehi dhammehi, so sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo va hotīti"
kv19.7:13.3: katvā tena ca kāraṇena atthi puthujjanassa accantaniyāmatā ti?
kv19.7:13.6: "Idha Bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti, ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi, ummujjitvā patarati, ummujjitvā paṭigādhappatto hotīti."
